sessions.description: Real-time urban flood depth mapping from traffic cameras using Gemini Vision AI
Complete system English localization and internationalization across Web UI, APIs, prompts, and documentation
Public CCTV camera live viewing, custom camera stream ingestion, and one-click camera snapshot flood depth analysis using Gemini Vision VLRDR

Dedicated Camera Management Backend (camera-backend) service with Ho Chi Minh City traffic camera provider (giaothong.hochiminhcity.gov.vn ~800 cameras) and upstream integration APIs for FloodWheel main backend
Error placeholder ('IMAGE NOT AVAILABLE') multi-factor detection, persistent disk snapshot storage, and last-known-good historical frame fallback for HCMC camera feeds
Interactive Map CCTV Visualization: Marker Clustering, Live Snapshot Preview Drawer, Viewport Filtering, and Dual Grid/Map Views for ~800 HCMC Traffic Cameras
Automated 30-minute CCTV flood analysis pipeline optimization, bug fixes, robust scheduling, and Admin portal live scanning monitor & controls
